offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures plumbing, water control and drinking water equipment for commercial, institutional and residential buildings. It sells mainly through plumbing wholesalers and independent sales representatives, with retail channels for residential products.

primary_products.value: backflow preventers and water control valves; drains and interceptors; faucets and flush valves; drinking fountains and bottle filling stations; sinks

customer_segment.value: B2B: Plumbing wholesalers, mechanical contractors, commercial building owners and private institutions; B2G: Public school districts, municipalities and other public facility operators; B2C: Homeowners and residential remodelers purchasing sinks and plumbing fixtures

end_markets.value: commercial construction and renovation; education; healthcare; public infrastructure; residential construction and remodeling

revenue_model.value: product sales: Plumbing equipment, drinking water fixtures, sinks, replacement parts and filters

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns metals, plastics and purchased components into plumbing and drinking water equipment for wholesalers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with operations in Mexico and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Water safety and control, drainage, hygienic fixtures, drinking water dispensers and sinks

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Plumbing wholesalers and specialty plumbing distributors; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives serving commercial plumbing markets; third-party retail: Home improvement retailers and kitchen and bath showrooms; online: Third-party e-commerce listings for sinks, fixtures and replacement filters
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; agents / brokers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Plumbing codes and Safe Drinking Water Act lead limits apply to equipment in contact with potable water

notes: The extent of sales outside North America is uncertain.
